levels.surface: عبيد الله بن عمر بن ميسرة

notes: «- المعنى -» between dashes is an editor's gloss, left out
Abu Dawud's remarks name other transmitters of Yahya's saying (Bishr b. al-Mufaddal and Malik; Abda; Ibn Uyayna): three variant groups, never routes (rule 4)
«قال سهل دخلت مربدا» and «قال حماد هذا أو نحوه» are the matn's own words and a wording remark: not chain links
«أن محيصة بن مسعود، وعبد الله بن سهل، انطلقا» : these are persons in the scene whose action is described, not links (rule 6)
